_doc: Generic defaults. A project overrides any key with a blender-perf.json (searched from the script's folder up to /; closest file wins, objects merge key by key). Relative paths in a blender-perf.json resolve from that file's folder.

ultra._doc: No path tracing. Runs the script, skips every render call, reports geometry/material/texture/camera stats. Workbench thumbnail only if the probe says headless Workbench works.

fast._doc: Look-check. Caps never raise a script's own values; thresholds never lower them.

quality._doc: Near-final look at a fraction of the cost: half resolution, about half the samples, lighting/bounces untouched.

final._doc: The deliverable. No quality setting is touched; only the compute device (and its denoiser) is chosen.
